function.name: cards_shuffle_and_draw
function.description: Shuffle a standard deck of 52 cards and draw a specified number of cards from the top. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

num_cards.description: Number of cards to be drawn. The default is 1 if no value is provided.
